decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 is down at TJ-C512-10 (radio and CMMS agree). The likely repair is 13:20. The stope holds 140 t at 13.4 gpt, about 60 oz. Central is not truck-limited (inflow 63 vs capacity 91 t/h). LH-08 comes from the infrastructure heading DS-N600-01, which costs only 0.5 oz/h. Travel is 0.69 h. At 29.1 t/h for an LH410, it clears the stope by about 15:00. The heading loss is about 3 oz at most. Taking LH-07 would cut another producing stope. Taking LH-09 would cost 2 oz/h.
